The files in this directory are upstream schemas. The tests render each policy kind
and validate it against the schema of its upstream API.

clusternetworkpolicies.v0.3.1.yaml
  The CRD of ClusterNetworkPolicy, standard channel, bundle v0.3.1. It serves v1alpha2 and v1beta1.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubernetes-sigs/network-policy-api/v0.3.1/config/crd/standard/policy.networking.k8s.io_clusternetworkpolicies.yaml
  sha256 865bc83dbc94c9c46e22c3c27657c8a2833812fdd5aa0f765f990ef39912db60

ciliumnetworkpolicies.v1.19.11.yaml
  The CRD of CiliumNetworkPolicy, Cilium v1.19.11.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cilium/cilium/v1.19.11/pkg/k8s/apis/cilium.io/client/crds/v2/ciliumnetworkpolicies.yaml
  sha256 1b1738a904de1152c43078e6a873440aea100f30f10ce5ed4e8622524c13fa43

networkpolicy.v1.36.6.schema.json
  The schemas that NetworkPolicy needs, from the OpenAPI v3 document of networking.k8s.io/v1 in Kubernetes v1.36.6.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/v1.36.6/api/openapi-spec/v3/apis__networking.k8s.io__v1_openapi.json
  The file keeps NetworkPolicy and the schemas that it refers to, and drops each description. It changes nothing else.
